title: Holiday Chasers manual fare row
description: One row of data/manual_fares.csv. Column order in the file is the order of required. Prices are EUR per person for 1 adult, taxes included, no bags. Rows whose screenshot_ref starts with EXAMPLE are fixtures and must not be published.

origin.description: Departure airport. Cork or Dublin only. Kerry (KIR) and Shannon (SNN) are rejected.

destination.description: Arrival IATA code that already has a Holiday Chasers page, or BVA for Paris Beauvais. Marrakesh (RAK) is rejected.

out_date.description: Outbound departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be in the past, and must be before or on the return date.

nights.description: Whole nights away. Must equal ret_date minus out_date.

trip_type.description: weekend and week fill the existing homepage boards. Any other slug, such as christmas, is kept for the destination page.

airline.description: Ryanair or Aer Lingus. The source URL host must match.

out_flight.description: Outbound flight number, such as FR1234.

out_time.description: Outbound departure time, 24-hour HH:MM, as shown on the airline page.

out_fare_eur.description: Outbound Basic Fare in EUR, greater than 0. Dot decimal, no thousands separator.

ret_fare_eur.description: Return Basic Fare in EUR, greater than 0.

total_pp_eur.description: Return total per person. Must equal the two Basic Fares within 0.50 EUR.

source_url.description: https URL of the airline page that was opened. ryanair.com for Ryanair, aerlingus.com for Aer Lingus.

checked_at_utc.description: When the fare was read, ISO 8601 with a timezone. Stored as UTC. Must not be in the future. Displayed in Europe/Dublin.

matched_shortlist.description: true when the Basic Fare total was within 0.50 EUR of the shortlist figure. The shortlist itself is not published.

seats_note.description: Optional. A seats-left note from the airline page. Empty if none. The word EXAMPLE marks a fixture.

screenshot_ref.description: Audit id for the saved screenshot. Not copied into deals_cache.json. A value starting with EXAMPLE is a fixture and cannot be published.
